user.title: Room thermostat
user.description: Control a thermostat to the temperature of the room that matters. Pick the thermostat to steer and the temperature sensors of the rooms to steer it by.

data_description.climate_entity: The real thermostat. Its setpoints are shifted so the chosen room reaches your target.
data_description.room_sensors: One sensor per room. A room's id is the sensor's entity id without the domain and a trailing "_temperature" (sensor.bedroom_temperature is bedroom).
data_description.reference_sensor: A sensor mounted next to the thermostat, used when the active room's sensor goes quiet and to remember the thermostat's own error.

error.no_rooms: Pick at least one room temperature sensor.
error.reference_not_a_room: The reference sensor must be one of the room sensors.
error.cannot_wrap_itself: Pick the real thermostat, not a room thermostat.

abort.already_configured: This thermostat already has a room thermostat.

data.manual_change_policy: When the thermostat is changed outside Home Assistant
data.unserved_rooms: Rooms this thermostat doesn't heat or cool

data_description.default_room: Room id, average or extreme. Used outside schedule blocks. Defaults to the reference room, else the average.
data_description.schedule_entity: A schedule helper. Each block's additional data may set room (id, name, average or extreme), heat and cool (room targets). A new block replaces manual choices and ends a hold.
data_description.manual_change_policy: Hold keeps the change for the hold duration (or until the next schedule block, or Resume). Adopt keeps the thermostat where it was put and moves the room target by the current offset.
data_description.stale_after_minutes: A room whose sensor has not reported for this long is skipped.
data_description.max_offset: Largest difference allowed between the thermostat's setpoint and the room target, in your temperature unit.
data_description.deadband: The thermostat is only rewritten when its setpoint is at least this far from what is wanted.
data_description.min_write_interval_minutes: Routine corrections wait at least this long. Target, mode, room and schedule changes are written right away.
data_description.smoothing_minutes: Time constant of the moving average applied to each room's offset.
data_description.setpoint_step: Commanded setpoints are rounded to this step.
data_description.minimum_range: Smallest heat_cool range your thermostat accepts (its heat/cool deadband). 0 if it has none.
data_description.hold_duration_minutes: How long a change made outside Home Assistant is respected before room control takes over again. A newer change restarts the clock. 0 holds until the next schedule block or Resume.
data_description.unserved_rooms: Room sensors from the list above in parts of the house this system doesn't reach (e.g. a room with its own mini split). Their temperatures are still shown and recorded, but they are never followed and don't count toward average or most off target.

error.unserved_not_a_room: Rooms the thermostat doesn't serve must also be in the room sensors.
error.no_served_rooms: At least one room must be one this thermostat heats or cools.
error.reference_unserved: The reference room must be one this thermostat heats or cools.
error.reference_not_a_room: The reference sensor must be one of the room sensors.
error.no_rooms: Pick at least one room temperature sensor.

options.hold: Hold for a while, then resume
options.adopt: Adopt as the new room target

range_too_narrow.message: Heat and cool targets must be at least {minimum} apart.

single_target_not_applicable.message: This mode has no single target temperature.
